clips.title: The story
paras: Young hunters at Camp Narache gather food and feathers for their people. Grull Hawkwind asks you to hunt plainstriders on Red Cloud Mesa, where the village depends on what the young can provide.

On Red Cloud Mesa, the tauren hunt to feed and clothe their people. They also value the stalk and chase as a test of discipline and a sport. When Camp Narache's stores run low, the young hunters gather plainstrider meat for cooking and feathers for tribal garments.

Grull Hawkwind judges the newcomers who hope to leave Red Cloud Mesa for the wider plains of Mulgore. Before they can meet his father, Chief Hawkwind, he asks them to prove their ability. A successful hunt shows self-reliance and helps support the tribe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. Traveler hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as an adventurer before the Chief.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The traveler of Narache thank you, friend. You show much promise.
